_matrixAnalyse: This ad group has a clear credential-seeking profile. 'Cyber security' (122 clk, CVR 9.0%) is the volume anchor, but the highest converters reveal the real intent : 'ethical hacking' (4 clk, CVR 50.0%), 'bachelor cyber security' (16 clk, CVR 12.5%), and 'cybersecurity bachelor's' (7 clk, CVR 14.3%) all signal that formal qualification matters. 'AWS security certification' (1 clk, CVR 100%) and 'hacking course' (10 clk, CVR 10.0%) confirm the technical specialisation angle. Pattern B : 'it security internship' (17 clk, CVR 0%) — they want work experience, not just training. The page must feel professional-grade, not like a casual bootcamp.
